blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. You can spend these 2 days exploring independently or choose optional excursions.

One option is a sightseeing tour of the historic and modern center of Caracas.

Another option is Colonia Tovar, a small mountain town founded in 1843 by German immigrants.

You can visit the Santa Teresa estate and Venezuelan rum distillery. The estate was founded by Martín Tovar Blanco in 1796, and in 1802 the Tovar family received a princely title from the King of Spain for the quality of their rum.

**Meals:** breakfast.
